dimensions.opening_height_basis: Derived from estimated top minus estimated sill, not separately measured.
dimensions.interpretation: Homeowner clarified feet-and-inches notation: sill 1 ft 5 in, depth 1 ft 3 in, north-corner gap 1 ft 4 in. All remain estimates.

placement.w06_gap_basis: Current modeled living-window; neither opening is site surveyed.
placement.balcony_outline: An edge relationship was reported, but the matching edges remain unresolved; do not claim alignment.

depth_hold.homeowner_report: The existing niche extends beyond the 9-inch wall and is reinforced, with an extended slab top to bottom throughout the building, as reported by the homeowner.
depth_hold.meaning: The reported extension is not represented or dimensioned in this model. The mismatch is not evidence that the existing niche is impossible or structurally unsafe.
depth_hold.required: Measure the existing niche and wall/extension on site and confirm relevant support and capacity with the responsible structural professional.
